purpose: Two new concept previews; existing game assets are unchanged.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single polished landscape gameplay art concept, 16:10 composition, for the physics-driven side-view game Ragdoll Volleyball in the Last Chance Resort setting.
The resort's automated concierge makes ordinary tourists win beach volleyball to earn their return tickets. Create a modern vivid high-quality 3D game render with realistic adult anatomy and materials, but a deliberately simple, low-detail scenic backdrop.
Gameplay composition is mandatory: almost orthographic straight side view, no tilted camera, no diagonal perspective floor. The actual collision floor is one perfectly horizontal, clearly visible continuous line at 87% of image height. Give it a narrow pale sand/stone rim above a dark solid shallow foreground plinth. This is a flat beach playing surface; a distant curved shoreline must not be confused with the floor. Full-height solid resort service walls occupy the outer 4% on each side, with straight bright inner wall edges at x=4% and x=96%, meeting the floor sharply; both are entirely visible. Each wall has one simple circular service button around y=70%. At x=50%, show a thin vertical volleyball divider pole rising from the floor to y=66%, with only a narrow edge-on strip of mesh. No wide net across the view.
Two fully visible adult tourists with warm bright skin, clean readable silhouettes, and anatomically proportionate articulated limbs: left player an athletic man with dark wavy hair, teal holiday shorts and pale wristbands; right player an athletic woman with tied-back hair, coral sports top and coral shorts with pale trim. Each player's upright anatomical height equals about 17% of the image height; do not make them enormous poster characters. Man at x=33% jumps toward a clearly visible yellow/blue volleyball at x=40%, y=61%, one knee bent, limbs naturally loose. Woman at x=72% braces on the floor with feet at y=87%, arms apart preparing to return the ball. Emphasize game physics with grounded contact shadows and believable airborne poses, no floating foot contact, no giant special effects. Keep all feet, hands, heads inside the frame.
Warm skin and saturated costumes must have strong luminance and hue contrast against cool muted dark sand, water, and scenery. Add gentle pale rim lighting but no cartoon outline. Behind the active players, large quiet dark shapes and plenty of negative space, not busy vegetation or architecture. Clearly distinguish the ball and narrow net.
Prepare composition for later background animation: two or three separated sparse palm crowns in the outer background with clear sky around leaf tips, dark trunks anchored behind the court, a broad unobstructed horizontal ocean band around y=50–75%, and two small separate plant clusters near outer walls behind the arena, never over the floor edge or player silhouettes. Palm leaves can curve gently with the same breeze; use a few broad wave ribbons and reflections rather than frozen tiny foam detail. Keep hotel, arena floor line, wall edges, and net rigid and static-looking. These are gameplay concept stills, not diagrams.
No HUD, no text, no arrows, no labels, no collage, no inset panels, no motion blur, no dense city/resort, no crowds, no boats, no detailed rocks, no flowers covering the foreground, no oversaturated high-contrast background texture. Keep the entire composition uncropped.
Variant: MOONLIT LAGOON. Realistic restrained AAA 3D rendering. Midnight-blue sky with a single small moon and minimal soft clouds; dark navy turquoise sea with a few broad silver moonlight ribbons. Cool slate-blue sand and deep blue foreground plinth. Only one low distant resort hotel silhouette at upper right, with a handful of softly glowing amber windows, no dense terraces. Three sparse palms, muted and gently backlit. Pale warm-gray stone service walls with thin cool-white readable inner edges, left button teal and right button coral. Warm subtle hotel lighting illuminates the players' skin while the sand behind them stays dark. The scene should feel tropical, luminous, calm and playable, not a cinematic busy illustration.

Warm amber key light on tourists and a restrained lavender rim light; coral and teal clothing remain strongly saturated against the quiet background. The arena must feel like a carefully art-directed modern game screenshot: vivid playable objects, reduced background complexity, easily extracted plant and ocean regions for animation.
